h1: Kitesurf is now open source
seo.meta_description: Kitesurf, our experimental browser engine for AI agents, is now open source. Inspect the code, run it locally, or deploy your own instance on Cloudflare Workers.
seo.title: Kitesurf is now open source | Cloudflare Blog

h1: Adapting to AI penetration testing orchestrators: The Modern Security Model
seo.meta_description: AI-orchestrated penetration testing platforms like ARTEX have become increasingly powerful tools enabling effective attacks on exposed infrastructure.
seo.title: Adapting to AI penetration testing orchestrators: The Modern Security Model | Cloudflare Blog

h1: Introducing Spend Management: Spending limits and alerts for Cloudflare
seo.meta_description: Spend Management adds opt-in spending caps for Workers and Durable Objects, and more products soon. Here's how we built it.
seo.title: Introducing Spend Management: Spending limits and alerts for Cloudflare | Cloudflare Blog

h1: Introducing Zero Wire, a hub for investigating critical Internet vulnerabilities
seo.meta_description: Zero Wire on Cloudflare Radar pairs plain-language briefings with global attack telemetry and remediation steps. Triage critical CVEs faster and decide how to protect your infrastructure.
seo.title: Introducing Zero Wire, a hub for investigating critical Internet vulnerabilities | Cloudflare Blog

h1: Choosing QuePaxa, an unusual consensus algorithm
seo.meta_description: Cloudflare is building an experimental consensus service using a never-before-deployed consensus algorithm, QuePaxa. Here's how it works and why we chose it.
seo.title: Choosing QuePaxa, an unusual consensus algorithm | Cloudflare Blog

h1: Agents aren’t humans (but they kinda are)
seo.meta_description: AI agents act for millions, but servers see intermediaries that strip user visibility. This post defines the problem space and introduces a collaborative approach to safely identifying, allowing, and managing this automated traffic.
seo.title: Agents aren’t humans (but they kinda are) | Cloudflare Blog

h1: The post-quantum future of web privacy
seo.meta_description: Cryptographic protocols help keep web sites safe from abuse while keeping their users private. Here's a look at the quantum threat to these protocols.
seo.title: The post-quantum future of web privacy | Cloudflare Blog

h1: Code Mode: The better way to use MCP
seo.meta_description: It turns out we've all been using MCP wrong. Most agents today use MCP by exposing the "tools" directly to the LLM. We tried something different: Convert the MCP tools into a TypeScript API, and then ask an LLM to write code that calls that API. The results are striking.
seo.title: Code Mode: the better way to use MCP | Cloudflare Blog

h1: Localizing compliance at scale: Achieving South Korea’s ISMS certification
seo.meta_description: Cloudflare has achieved South Korea's ISMS certification following an audit across 80 controls. Learn how we localized user consent flows, adapted social sign-up paths at the edge, and validated our global security program.
seo.title: Localizing compliance at scale: Achieving South Korea’s ISMS certification | Cloudflare Blog

h1: See the agents, set the terms: New visibility and control for personal agents
seo.meta_description: Personal AI agents have changed how users interact with the web. Learn how Cloudflare gives site owners visibility and control to manage personal agent access.
seo.title: See the agents, set the terms: new visibility and control for personal agents | Cloudflare Blog

h1: Introducing Clef: Our open-source decision models, and new RL fine-tuning platform
seo.meta_description: We are introducing Clef and Clef-flash, open-source decision models hosted on Workers AI for high-speed classification and agentic workflows. Also launching: a new reinforcement learning platform that allows developers to fine-tune decision models using their own data.
seo.title: Introducing Clef: our open-source decision models, and new RL fine-tuning platform | Cloudflare Blog

h1: Launching the Vite Ecosystem Fund
seo.meta_description: Cloudflare is distributing the first $301,300 of the Vite Ecosystem Fund to open source projects and maintainers.
seo.title: Launching the Vite Ecosystem Fund | Cloudflare Blog

h1: 4 real? Tracking exploitation and patching of eMudhra’s weak keys
seo.meta_description: Four, just four: that’s the key to break into any unpatched connection on the Internet that is using eMudhra certificates. Here’s how we quickly patched Cloudflare, what evidence we can see of attempted exploitation, and how much of the rest of the Internet remains exposed.
seo.title: 4 real? Tracking exploitation and patching of eMudhra’s weak keys | Cloudflare Blog

h1: How we halved DNS build delay and cut memory use by 85%
seo.meta_description: Zone setting changes used to rebuild entire DNS zones, even ones with tens of millions of records. Here is how we built a planner that picks the smallest safe build, cutting full builds by 40%, peak memory by 85%, and halving build delay.
seo.title: How we halved DNS build delay and cut memory use by 85% | Cloudflare Blog

h1: Cloudflare services for private origins is now generally available
seo.meta_description: Public traffic to private origins, with WAF, bot management, caching, and Workers, is now available to every customer with Cloudflare One connectivity.
seo.title: Cloudflare services for private origins is now generally available | Cloudflare Blog

h1: Introducing the Cloudflare PHP Capture the Flag challenge
seo.meta_description: We are launching a PHP Capture the Flag challenge integrated with our Bug Bounty program to test our WAF protections. Security researchers are invited to bypass our defenses and capture the flag to help make the Internet safer.
seo.title: Introducing the Cloudflare PHP Capture the Flag challenge | Cloudflare Blog

h1: Cloudflare DDoS Threat Report 2026 Q3: More swarms, fewer giants
seo.meta_description: Cloudflare mitigated over 8,200 DDoS attacks per hour in Q3 2026 as attackers shifted to shorter, high-frequency strikes. Explore the latest threat data, including the collapse of CLDAP vectors and the impact of recent botnet takedowns.
seo.title: Cloudflare DDoS Threat Report 2026 Q3: More swarms, fewer giants | Cloudflare Blog

h1: Introducing Zero Round Trip Time Resumption (0-RTT)
seo.meta_description: Cloudflare’s mission is to help build a faster and more secure Internet. Over the last several years, the Internet Engineering Task Force (IETF) has been working on a new version of TLS, the protocol that powers the secure web.
seo.title: Introducing Zero Round Trip Time Resumption (0-RTT) | Cloudflare Blog

h1: What took the Internet offline in Q3 2026
seo.meta_description: An examination of global Internet disruptions observed by Cloudflare Radar during the third quarter of 2026. This review analyzes how power failures, natural disasters, and government shutdowns impacted network connectivity and traffic.
seo.title: What Took the Internet Offline in Q3 2026 | Cloudflare Blog

h1: Cross-request KV cache exposure in the GLM-5.3 Workers AI model, and our remediation with SGLang
seo.meta_description: A configuration mismatch in GLM 5.3 on Workers AI triggered an SGLang bug that exposed KV cache pages across requests. Here is how we addressed the issue.
seo.title: Cross-request KV cache exposure in the GLM-5.3 Workers AI model, and our remediation with SGLang | Cloudflare Blog

h1: Origin Range Requests: Serving large files without range-request tuning
seo.meta_description: Naive byte-range caching can waste gigabytes of origin bandwidth on small requests. We rebuilt our cache architecture in Pingora to coordinate partial fetches automatically, cutting R2 p99 latency in half.
seo.title: Origin Range Requests: Serving large files without range-request tuning | Cloudflare Blog

h1: Bringing post-quantum cryptography to geographically fenced key management
seo.meta_description: Cloudflare's new post-quantum GeoKey Manager protects geographically fenced decryption keys from harvest now, decrypt later attacks. Learn how we redesigned our cryptography stack to support strict data sovereignty in a post-quantum world.
seo.title: Bringing post-quantum cryptography to geographically fenced key management | Cloudflare Blog

h1: Cloudflare deploys protections against php2shell vulnerability
seo.meta_description: Cloudflare has deployed default web application firewall (WAF) protections for newly disclosed PHP vulnerabilities before public disclosure. The rules use request and response signals to stop exploit attempts and prevent exposed data from reaching attackers.
seo.title: Cloudflare deploys protections against php2shell vulnerability | Cloudflare Blog

h1: Introducing tsrs: A port of TypeScript to Rust
seo.meta_description: Cloudflare is collaborating on tsrs, a Rust port of TypeScript that is up to 8x faster and uses 70% less memory.
seo.title: Introducing tsrs: a Port of TypeScript to Rust | Cloudflare Blog

h1: 8 eMudhra certificates are compromised. Here's what you need to know
seo.meta_description: Following the discovery that eight eMudhra intermediate certificates use weak keys, Cloudflare is deploying mitigations and releasing client updates. We explain the impact, our response, and what customers and developers should do next.
seo.title: 8 eMudhra certificates are compromised. Here's what you need to know | Cloudflare Blog

h1: Introducing full transaction detection for Cloudflare WAF
seo.meta_description: Cloudflare's web application firewall can now correlate an HTTP request with its response. Full transaction detection helps every customer find successful exploits, data exposure, and risky misconfigurations that request-only inspection can miss.
seo.title: Introducing full transaction detection for Cloudflare WAF | Cloudflare Blog

h1: How Commerce.com and Cloudflare are getting storefronts ready for AI agents
seo.meta_description: Almost 100,000 Commerce.com domains now give AI agents real shopping tools through WebMCP on Cloudflare. Here's how we turned it on across every store at once, while keeping each merchant in control.
seo.title: How Commerce.com and Cloudflare are getting storefronts ready for AI agents | Cloudflare Blog

h1: A fully programmable secure web gateway
seo.meta_description: Cloudflare Gateway and Data Loss Prevention have inherited the flexibility and power of Cloudflare Workers through our full-stack integration with the Cloudflare Developer platform.
seo.title: A fully programmable secure web gateway | Cloudflare Blog

h1: Cutting our inference bill by 68% by being obsessive about optimization
seo.meta_description: When our AI code reviewer's cost per run doubled, we dug into the token usage to find out why. Learn how we used prompt caching and intelligent model routing to slash our inference bill by 68% while speeding up reviews.
seo.title: Cutting our inference bill by 68% by being obsessive about optimization | Cloudflare Blog

h1: Introducing Clairic, a new System One class of extraction models
seo.meta_description: Clairic is a new model from Cloudflare that is a System One extraction modeI, capable of extracting, computing, estimating, and forecasting data from unstructured inputs.
seo.title: Introducing Clairic, a new System One class of extraction models | Cloudflare Blog

h1: Beyond the patch: Protecting your NetScaler gateway against future vulnerabilities
seo.meta_description: CVE-2026-88771 lets attackers run commands on NetScaler Gateway before anyone signs in. Patching takes time most teams don't have, so the sign-in decision has to move in front of the vulnerable code.
seo.title: There's always a patient zero: Defending the NetScaler front door before the patch | Cloudflare Blog

h1: Generating Documentation for TypeScript Projects
seo.meta_description: Traditionally, JavaScript docs use code comments. This post explores generating documentation directly from TypeScript source code, a more efficient alternative.
seo.title: Generating Documentation for TypeScript Projects | Cloudflare Blog

h1: Continuous accountability for Verified bots
seo.meta_description: Identity alone doesn't guarantee a bot will behave responsibly. We are introducing a system to continuously evaluate whether Verified bots honor site preferences, like robots.txt and HTTP 429s, ensuring they remain accountable over time.
seo.title: Continuous accountability for Verified bots | Cloudflare Blog

h1: Inside Hyperdrive: How we solved a rare Hyperdrive MySQL caching bug
seo.meta_description: While adding MySQL support to Hyperdrive, we found a subtle protocol bug when caching query results.
seo.title: Inside Hyperdrive: How we solved a rare Hyperdrive MySQL caching bug | Cloudflare Blog

h1: Cloudflare and OpenAI: Making AI discovery better for everyone
seo.meta_description: How Cloudflare and OpenAI are working together to help AI find useful content, keep up with changes, and make fewer wasted requests – making the experience better for users and website owners alike.
seo.title: Cloudflare and OpenAI: making AI discovery better for everyone | Cloudflare Blog

h1: Deploy with Void
seo.meta_description: Introducing Void: an open-source SDK, CLI, and self-hosted platform for building full-stack Vite apps and deploying them to Cloudflare.
seo.title: Deploy with Void | Cloudflare Blog

h1: Rewinding the exponential: How we keep hardware usage down
seo.meta_description: Our strategies to optimize our data pipeline throughput without compromising data quality.
seo.title: Rewinding the exponential: How we keep hardware usage down | Cloudflare Blog

h1: Yandex outage: Data shows that instead of going dark, malicious bots went on the move

seo.title: Yandex outage: data shows that instead of going dark, malicious bots went on the move | Cloudflare Blog

h1: Under the hood, off the hot path: How D1 scales to millions of databases
seo.meta_description: A deep dive into how D1 architected its control plane to scale and manage millions of databases, while keeping data plane query operations at the edge. We share guiding principles on how to build on the Developer Platform effectively.
seo.title: Under the hood, off the hot path: how D1 scales to millions of databases | Cloudflare Blog

seo.meta_description: The Deno team is joining Cloudflare to radically simplify self-hosting Workers and Durable Objects, so developers can use the same primitives in more places.
seo.title: Deno is joining Cloudflare | Cloudflare Blog

seo.title: Filter, reshape, and redact logs before export with Transformers | Cloudflare Blog

h1: Introducing Clef-omni with full multimodality, plus a faster Clef and a cheaper Clef-flash
seo.meta_description: We are expanding the Clef decision model family with Clef-omni, natively processing audio, video, images, and text in a single pipeline.
seo.title: Introducing Clef-omni with full multimodality, plus a faster Clef and a cheaper Clef-flash | Cloudflare Blog

h1: Introducing on-demand CPU and memory profiling with flamegraphs for Workers and Durable Objects
seo.meta_description: On-demand CPU and memory profiling for Cloudflare Workers and Durable Objects is now available. Now you can generate interactive flamegraphs directly in production to quickly track down memory leaks and performance bottlenecks.

h1: Bridging technical depth and usability: The story behind Radar’s redesign
seo.meta_description: We redesigned Cloudflare Radar to make real-time global traffic and outage data accessible to a wider audience — including journalists, less technical researchers, and everyday users. By introducing an interactive map and standardized components, we simplified navigation while preserving technical depth.
seo.title: Bridging technical depth and usability: The story behind Radar’s redesign | Cloudflare Blog

seo.title: Answering the Critical Question: Can You Get Private SSL Keys Using Heartbleed? | Cloudflare Blog

h1: The Heartbleed Aftermath: all CloudFlare certificates revoked and reissued

h1: Universal SSL: How It Scales
seo.meta_description: On Monday, we announced Universal SSL, enabling HTTPS for all websites using CloudFlare’s Free plan. Universal SSL represents a massive increase in the number of sites we serve over HTTPS—from tens of thousands, to millions.
seo.title: Universal SSL: How It Scales | Cloudflare Blog

h1: The Web is World-Wide, or who still needs RC4?

h1: Logjam: the latest TLS vulnerability explained
